title: PV Defect Screening Under Acquisition Shift: Robustness and Calibration (code and results)
description: Stress tests of an interpretable electroluminescence defect-screening model (ELPV, 2,624 cells) under exposure, contrast, noise and blur shifts, with calibration (Brier, ECE) and a selective-review rule. Follow-up to Hoque (2026), IJSRA 20(2).
